title: MeaSeq Output Schema
description: The MeaSeq-specific schema used for validating IRIDA Next JSON output data

anyOf.description: Software versions used by the pipeline.
Final report with all metrics and visualizations included
Final combined QC file in excel format that also includes the genomes and N450s in FASTA format
TSV file containing the different run-level Novel-HASH DSId calls along with its corresponding N450 sequence
CSV file containing each samples predicted genotype along with metrics regarding the prediction quality
Amplicon report containing plots and metrics to show how well each amplicon was sequenced
Sample N450 sequence extracted from the final consensus sequence
Final sample consensus sequence with variants applied and low depth/quality sites masked
Freebayes identified and BCFTools normalized Illumina variants passing the variant filters and applied to the final consensus sequence
Index of iVar primertrimmed coordinate sorted BAM file containing read alignment information.
iVar amplicon primertrimmed coordinate sorted BAM file of reads reads mapped to the given reference
Clair3 identified and BCFTools normalized Nanopore variants passing the variant filters and applied to the final consensus sequence
Index of the artic primertrimmed coordinate alignments file
Artic amplicon primertrimmed coordinate sorted BAM file of reads mapped to the given reference

genotype.description: Detected measles genotype for the sample

reference.description: Reference genome used for the analysis of the sample

matched_dsid.description: DSId assigned to the sample. Either a novel designation with a hash or a match to the provided DSId file

dsid_file_used.description: The input DSId file used to assign DSIds

num_input_reads.description: Number of reads initially put into the pipeline for the sample

num_aligned_reads.description: Number of reads aligned to the reference for the sample

num_consensus_n.description: Number of Ns found in the final sample consensus sequence

genome_completeness_percent.description: Percent of the samples genome covered by base calls

mean_sequencing_depth.description: Mean sequencing depth across the genome for the sample

median_sequencing_depth.description: Median sequencing depth across the genome for the sample

total_variants.description: Number of variants (SNPs and INDELs) compared to the reference for the sample

num_snps.description: Number of SNPs identified in the sample compared to the reference

num_iupac.description: Number of IUPAC variants (from ambiguous sites in Illumina data) identified in the sample

num_deletions.description: Number of deletion variant sites identified in the sample compared to the reference

num_deletion_sites.description: Total number of deleted bases compared to the reference

num_insertions.description: Number of insertion variant sites identified in the sample compared to the reference

num_insertion_sites.description: Total number of inserted bases compared to the reference

genome_length.description: Length of the final sample consensus genome generated

divisible_by_6.description: QC flag displaying if the samples final genome length is divisible by 6

frameshifts.description: QC status displaying any frameshift variants identified with Nextclade

nonsense_mutation.description: QC status displaying any nonsense variants identified with Nextclade

mutated_stop_codon.description: QC status displaying any mutated stop codons identified with Nextclade

variants.description: Semicolon separated list of all variants identified in the sample formatted as RefPosAlt

sequencing_primer_variants.description: Semicolon separated list of all variants overlapping a sequencing primer region in the sample

N450_completeness.description: Percentage of the samples N450 diagnostic region covered by base calls

N450_mean_depth.description: Mean depth of the samples N450 diagnostic region

N450_status.description: Status of the samples N450 diagnostic region taking into account completeness, ambiguity, and INDELs

qc_status.description: Overall QC status of the sample. PASS for fully passing, a semicolon separated list of identified issues otherwise

run_status.description: Overall run status. Mostly just checks if there are negative controls and if they are contaminated giving either PASS or WARN

num_masked.description: Number of low quality sites identified and masked in Nanopore data
